title: Specified sources with no implementation at all
description:
SPEC-HIRE.md 'Sources (Attestor Plugins)' specifies sources that have no module in hire-attestors/src/ whatsoever. Distinct from persona-qbnm, where the module exists and only prove() is missing: here there is nothing to finish.

Verified 2026-09-15 against the tree. hire-attestors/src/ contains claim, did_key, fido2, goa, gpg, lib, oidc, piv, registry, ssh, tailscale, unix. Nothing else.

DAY-ONE SOURCES WITH NO MODULE:
  secure-enclave  macOS TouchID/FaceID via LocalAuthentication + CryptoTokenKit
  did:web         SPEC groups it under 'did-self' with did:key, but it is a
                  different trust model -- iaa2, resolved over HTTPS
  windows-hello   NOT FILED HERE. It belongs to persona-vvs2: hired does not
                  run on Windows at all, so the attestor is not the gate. Do
                  not duplicate it into this epic.

DAY-TWO SOURCES, none with a module: aws-sso, gcloud, az, bitwarden, kerberos.

Every child inherits the persona-qbnm constraints: declare proof cost and attainable tier (persona-jl4j.3), and if the source cannot answer a challenge, answer persona-ux32 before writing prove().
